name: En-dor
line: Endor was a city in Issachar given to Manasseh, where King Saul sought out a medium on the night before his last battle.

moments.title: Saul visits the medium
moments.text: After the LORD did not answer him, Saul disguised himself and went at night to a medium at Endor. He asked her to bring up Samuel for him.

moments.title: A place of defeat
moments.text: Psalm 83 remembers Endor as a place where Sisera and Jabin perished. The psalmist asks God to deal with Israel's enemies in the same way.
